G1.basis_zh: 冻结 source 与候选 ZIP 对应 TASK 字节一致。
G1.basis_en: Frozen source bytes match the candidate ZIP TASK.

G2.basis_zh: 已重算并匹配 source SHA-256。
G2.basis_en: Source SHA-256 was recomputed and matched.

G3.basis_zh: E001–E008 可在冻结 source 回放。

G4.basis_zh: 八个槽位仅按 Source 与空 Context 审定。
G4.basis_en: All eight slots use only Source and empty Context.

G5.basis_zh: N 的七条上限已明确，五至七条仅为建议；原文允许接收者拍板。仅主观验收保持 unresolved，未伪造阈值。
G5.basis_en: The seven-rule cap is binding, while five to seven is guidance and the recipient chooses N; only subjective acceptance remains unresolved.

G6.basis_zh: 未声明 ontology 或权限绑定。
G6.basis_en: No ontology or authority binding is asserted.

G7.basis_zh: FormalCoverageGap 与 invented_constraints 均为空。

G8.basis_zh: 固定模型与不确定性结果可重放。
G8.basis_en: Fixed model and underdetermination result are replayable.

G9.basis_zh: N 的受约束选择不构成边界歧义；主观质量验收仍影响边界。
G9.basis_en: The constrained choice of N does not change the boundary; subjective quality acceptance still does.

G10.basis_zh: Profile 缺失，Policy 未评估；未确定边界正确阻断准入。
G10.basis_en: Profile is missing; Policy is not evaluated; underdetermination correctly blocks admission.

final_reason_zh: G1–G10 均通过；本案被准确审定为 underdetermined，未生成 ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN。
final_reason_en: G1–G10 pass; this case is accurately adjudicated as underdetermined and no ADMIN_GOLD_FROZEN is generated.
